title: Debating Ethical Dilemmas / Debate n'ihü n'ime ndoro ndoro etike
bridge: Na Igbo, tụọ asụsụ anyị nwere ike ịmalite na ndoro ndoro nke subjunctive n'oge tụọ asụsụ ndoro ndoro n'oge tụọ asụsụ ndoro ndoro n'oge tụọ asụsụ ndoro ndoro. Na Englishi, ndoro ndoro nke subjunctive adịghị mma; ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro. N'agbanyeghị, na ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro 'should' na 'would' n'ime ndoro ndoro na ndoro ndoro na ndoro ndoro na ndoro ndoro na ndoro ndoro. N'agbanyeghị, tụọ asụsụ ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro.
rule: Iji tụọ asụsụ Englishi na B2, biko jiri: 1) 'I think/ believe/ feel' + clause n'ime ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro (adịghị ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro). 2) Modals: 'should' (ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro), 'ought to' (ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro), 'must' (ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro), 'can't' (ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro), 'could' (ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro), 'would' (ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro). 3) Nkwenye ndoro ndoro na ndoro ndoro: 'I agree with... because...', 'I see your point, but...', 'That may be true, however...'. 4) Conditional na ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro: 'If we allowed... , then...' (ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro), 'If I were in that situation, I would...' (ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro). 5) Nkwenye ndoro ndoro: 'therefore', 'moreover', 'nevertheless', 'although'. Gbalịa ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro ('I don't agree with nothing' adịghị mma) na tụọ asụsụ ndoro ndoro n'ime ndoro ndoro: 'Not only is it unethical, but also...'.

title: Strategic Language for Negotiations / Mmalite ndoro nke ndoro nke
bridge: N'igbo, anyị na-eme ka ndoro nke dịrị mma na usoro nke ndoro nke, nke a na-akpọ 'quisiera' ma ọ bụ 'me gustaría', mgbe e nwere English, ha na-eme ka ndoro nke dịrị mma na usoro nke ndoro nke na-akpọ 'would', 'could' ma ọ bụ 'might' iji mee ka ndoro nke dịrị mma, mana na usoro nke ndoro nke. Mgbe ndoro nke na-akpọ 'no' na-akpọ 'I'm afraid' ma ọ bụ 'unfortunately' iji mee ka ndoro nke dịrị mma. Ndoro iche na ndoro nke 'de acuerdo' na-akpọ 'I am agree' - ndoro nke nwere ike ịbanye na 'agree' n'ọnụ ọgụgụ, mana ọ bụghị na usoro nke ndoro nke.
rule: N'ime ndoro nke na English na B2, ndoro nke na-eme ka ndoro nke dịrị mma na usoro nke ndoro nke (would, could, might, may). Usoro nke na-akpọ 'I would suggest...' ma ọ bụ 'We could consider...' na-eme ka ndoro nke dịrị mma ma ọ bụ 'I want...' ma ọ bụ 'You must...'. Mgbe ndoro nke na-akpọ 'What if...' ma ọ bụ 'How about...' na-eme ka ndoro nke dịrị mma na usoro nke ndoro nke. Mgbe ndoro nke na-akpọ 'I see your point, but...' ma ọ bụ 'I'm afraid that...' iji mee ka ndoro nke dịrị mma. Mgbe ndoro nke na-akpọ 'If... then...' iji mee ka ndoro nke dịrị mma. Ndoro iche na ndoro nke 'agree' na-akpọ ndoro nke, mana ọ bụghị adịective, nke a na-akpọ 'I am agree' mana ọ bụ 'I agree'.

common_error.explanation: Ndoro iche na ndoro nke na-akpọ 'estoy de acuerdo' (usando ndoro nke estar + ndoro nke sustantivo), na-akpọ 'I am agree' na English. Na English, 'agree' na-akpọ ndoro nke nwere ike ịbanye na 'coincidir' ma ọ bụ 'estar de acuerdo' mana ọ bụghị na usoro nke ndoro nke 'to be'. Iji mee ka ndoro nke adịghị iche, ndoro iche na ndoro nke 'agree' na-akpọ ndoro nke nwere ike ịbanye na 'coincidir' ma ọ bụ 'estar de acuerdo' mana ọ bụghị na usoro nke ndoro nke 'be'. Ndoro iche na ndoro nke 'completely' ma ọ bụ 'partially' iji mee ka ndoro nke dịrị mma.

title: Discussing Literature and Film / Gụọ asụsụ na nkọwa
bridge: Na Igbo, mgbakọ okwu zuru ezu maka ịkpọtụrụ ndoro ndoro na nkọwa nke akwụkwọ na nkọwa dị ka 'I found it...' ma ọ bụ 'It struck me as...' a na-eme n'ala Igbo, ndị a na-egosi n'okwu nke dị ka 'eme m ya...' ma ọ bụ 'nke mere m ya...'. N'ime ndoro ndoro Igbo, ụfọdụ nke ndoro ndoro dị n'okpuru nke ọ bụla (nke a na-egosi n'okwu nke dị ka 'akwụkwọ ndoro ndoro'), n'ihi na n'ala Igbo, ndoro ndoro ndị a na-egosi n'okpuru nke ọ bụla. N'ihi na n'ala Igbo, ụfọdụ nke ndoro ndoro dị n'okpuru nke ọ bụla (nke a na-egosi n'okwu nke dị ka 'akwụkwọ ndoro ndoro'). N'ihi na n'ala Igbo, ụfọdụ nke ndoro ndoro dị n'okpuru nke ọ bụla (nke a na-egosi n'okwu nke dị ka 'akwụkwọ ndoro ndoro'). N'ihi na n'ala Igbo, ụfọdụ nke ndoro ndoro dị n'okpuru nke ọ bụla.
rule: Iji gụọ asụsụ na nkọwa n'ala Igbo na B2, ị nwere ike ịnweta: 1) ịkpọtụrụ ndoro ndoro na ndoro ndoro dị ka 'I found it + ndoro ndoro' (I found it thought-provoking) ma ọ bụ 'It struck me as + ndoro ndoro' (It struck me as predictable). 2) Nkọwa nkọwa n'ime ụbọchị n'okpuru nke ọ bụla (The story follows a detective who uncovers a conspiracy). 3) Ime nkọwa n'ime ụbọchị n'okpuru nke ọ bụla (I read the book last year). 4) Nkọwa nkọwa n'ime ụbọchị n'okpuru nke ọ bụla (The movie is based on a novel). N'ihi na ndoro ndoro dị ka 'gripping', 'thought-provoking', 'predictable', 'far-fetched', 'moving' dị mma. Gbalịa ịgụnye 'me mere m ya' n'ime ndoro ndoro nke ọ bụla; jiri 'I thought' ma ọ bụ 'I found'.

common_error.wrong: The book is more interesting that the movie.
common_error.correct: The book is more interesting than the movie.
common_error.correct_alt: The book is more interesting compared to the movie.
common_error.explanation: Na Igbo, mgbakọ okwu zuru ezu maka ịkpọtụrụ ndoro ndoro dị ka 'than' ma ọ bụ 'that'. Ndị Igbo na-egosi n'okwu nke dị ka 'that' (nke, ndoro ndoro) na 'than' (nke, ndoro ndoro). Gbalịa ịmụta: mgbe ị na-akpọtụrụ ndoro ndoro n'ime ụfọdụ nke ọ bụla, jiri 'than'.

examples.original: I found the ending a bit predictable.
examples.phonetic: aɪ faʊnd ði ˈendɪŋ ə bɪt prɪˈdɪktəbəl.
examples.translation: A chọrọ m ya n'ime nkọwa a nke na-egosi n'okwu nke dị ka 'eme m ya'.
examples.note: Jiri 'I found + nke + ndoro ndoro' mgbe ị na-eme ndoro ndoro. Ọ dị mma karịa 'I think it was'.

examples.original: It struck me as a very thought-provoking film.
examples.phonetic: ɪt strʌk mi æz ə ˈveri ˈθɔːt prəˈvəʊkɪŋ fɪlm.
examples.translation: A chọrọ m ya n'ime nkọwa a nke na-egosi n'okwu nke dị ka 'eme m ya'.
examples.note: 'It struck me as' bụ okwu ndoro ndoro n'ime ndoro ndoro.

examples.original: The dialogue felt really natural.
examples.phonetic: ðə ˈdaɪəlɒɡ fɛlt ˈrɪəli ˈnætʃrəl.
examples.translation: A chọrọ m ya n'ime nkọwa a nke na-egosi n'okwu nke dị ka 'eme m ya'.
examples.note: Jiri 'feel' mgbe ị na-eme ndoro ndoro ndoro.

examples.original: The story follows a young detective who uncovers a conspiracy.
examples.phonetic: ðə ˈstɔːri ˈfɒləʊz ə jʌŋ dɪˈtɛktɪv huː ʌnˈkʌvəz ə kənˈspɪrəsi.
examples.translation: Nkọwa a na-akpọ n'ime ụbọchị n'okpuru nke ọ bụla nke na-egosi n'okwu nke dị ka 'eme m ya'.
examples.note: Jiri ụbọchị n'okpuru nke ọ bụla mgbe ị na-akpọtụrụ nkọwa.

examples.original: In the end, the protagonist realizes the truth.
examples.phonetic: ɪn ði end, ðə prəˈtæɡənɪst ˈrɪəlaɪzɪz ðə truːθ.
examples.translation: N'oge mgbasa oge, onye a na-akpọtụrụ n'ime nkọwa a nke na-egosi n'okwu nke dị ka 'eme m ya'.
examples.note: Jiri 'in the end' ma ọ bụ 'at the end' mgbe ị na-akpọtụrụ n'ime nkọwa.

examples.original: The plot twists unexpectedly when the villain is revealed.
examples.phonetic: ðə plɒt twɪsts ʌnɪkˈspɛktɪdli wɛn ðə ˈvɪlən ɪz rɪˈviːld.
examples.translation: Nkọwa a na-akpọ n'ime ụbọchị n'okpuru nke ọ bụla nke na-egosi n'okwu nke dị ka 'eme m ya'.
examples.note: Ụbọchị n'okpuru nke ọ bụla dị mma mgbe ị na-akpọtụrụ nkọwa.

examples.original: Whereas the book is very descriptive, the film relies on visual storytelling.
examples.phonetic: ˌweərˈæz ðə bʊk ɪz ˈveri dɪˈskrɪptɪv, ðə fɪlm rɪˈlaɪz ɒn ˈvɪʒuəl ˈstɔːritəlɪŋ.
examples.translation: Mgbe nkọwa a na-akpọ n'ime ụbọchị n'okpuru nke ọ bụla, nkọwa a na-akpọ n'ime nkọwa a nke na-egosi n'okwu nke dị ka 'eme m ya'.
examples.note: Jiri 'whereas' mgbe ị na-akpọtụrụ nkọwa n'ime ụfọdụ nke ọ bụla. Na Igbo, ọ bụrụ na 'mgbe na'.

examples.original: The movie adaptation leaves out a lot of the subplots.
examples.phonetic: ðə ˈmuːvi ˌædæpˈteɪʃən liːvz aʊt ə lɒt ɒv ðə ˈsʌbplɒts.
examples.translation: Nkọwa a na-akpọ n'ime ụbọchị n'okpuru nke ọ bụla nke na-egosi n'okwu nke dị ka 'eme m ya'.
examples.note: 'Leave out' bụ okwu ndoro ndoro n'ime ndoro ndoro. Ọ dị mma n'ime ndoro ndoro nkọwa.

examples.original: Unlike the original, the remake has a more optimistic ending.
examples.phonetic: ʌnˈlaɪk ði əˈrɪdʒɪnəl, ðə ˈriːmeɪk hæz ə mɔːr ˌɒptɪˈmɪstɪk ˈendɪŋ.
examples.translation: N'ihi na nkọwa a na-akpọ n'ime ụbọchị n'okpuru nke ọ bụla, nkọwa a na-akpọ n'ime nkọwa a nke na-egosi n'okwu nke dị ka 'eme m ya'.
examples.note: Jiri 'unlike' n'ime okpuru nke ọ bụla mgbe ị na-akpọtụrụ nkọwa.
